note: Independent re-audit against RFC 9069 Section 4.2 ('The unused bits are reserved for future use. They MUST be transmitted as 0') at HEAD. locRIBPeerHeader (bmp_locrib.go) is the sole PeerTypeLocRIB constructor and sets Flags=0; writePeerHeader (header.go) writes Flags unmodified. TestLocRIBPeerHeader asserts PeerType==PeerTypeLocRIB and Flags==0 (fails on any set bit). Single-polarity annotation holds (no Ze path sets any reserved bit on PeerType=3). Note: the row quotes only the transmit half; the receipt-ignore clause is not in this row.
